shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'find .. -name AGENTS.md -print && cat package.json && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/product/page.tsx && cat lib/data.ts && cat next.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '930,975p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js && rg -n 'clientSegmentCache =|clientSegmentCache:' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head -20 && rg -n 'cacheComponents.*clientSegmentCache|clientSegmentCache.*cacheComponents' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' -m 2 | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'latest canary|experimental.ppr.*canary|experimental.useCache.*canary|cacheComponents.*canary' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head -35 && sed -n '700,780p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js && sed -n '1,90p' package-lock.json"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -F 'can only be enabled when using the latest canary' node_modules/next/dist --glob '*.js' --glob '"'!*.map'"' --glob '"'!compiled/**'"' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'CanaryOnlyError|canary-only' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js node_modules/next/dist/server/*.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js -g '*.js' | head -35 && rg -n 'cacheComponents|useCache|ppr' node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head -45"
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version && npm view next version && git diff -- package.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'prefetch=\\{true\\}|unstable_forceStale|PPRRuntime' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js | tail -20 && sed -n '345,405p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js && cat next.config.ts && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules -g '*playwright*' -g '*puppeteer*' | head -15 && rg -n 'NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER|NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER|NEXT_ROUTER_STALE_TIME_HEADER' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache-impl/cache.js | head -35 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && cat next-env.d.ts && ls .next/server/app | head -30 && rg -n 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Loading related' .next/server/app/product* -g '*.html' -g '*.rsc' -g '*.prefetch.rsc' | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app/product.segments -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\\n' && find .next/server/app/product -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\\n' | head -30 && wc -c .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.meta && rg -n -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.segments/* 2>/dev/null | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.segments/* .next/server/app/product.segments/product/* 2>/dev/null | head -40 && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*product*' -printf '%p %s bytes\\n' && find .next/server/app/product.segments -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\\n'"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=test' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=test' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'force-dynamic|dynamic =|dynamic rendering|static prerender' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -70 && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/prefetch.md | sed -n '1,125p' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md | sed -n '1,125p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'function prefetch\\(|function prefetchStage|prefetch\\(\\).*static prerender|does not affect.*prerender' node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' -m 2 | head -35 && rg -n -F 'prefetch()' node_modules/next/dist/server/request/prefetch.js node_modules/next/dist/server/request/navigation.js 2>/dev/null | head -55"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -F 'NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache -g '*.js' | head -25 && rg -n 'segment-prefetch|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch|next-router-prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache -g '*.js' | head -40 && rg -n 'segment-prefetch|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch|next-router-prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' -m 2 | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_tree' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_index' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' .next/server/app/product.html .next/server/app/product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | head -20 && npm run start -- -p 3111"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /product/__PAGE__' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1'  'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc 'tail -25 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md && git diff --stat && git status --short && cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- .gitignore app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts package.json && node -e \"const p=require('./package-lock.json'); console.log(p.packages[''].dependencies.next, p.packages['node_modules/next'].version)\""
/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 3' 'http://localhost:3111/product' | rg -o 'Compact Widget|Widget Carry Case|Premium Widget|Related products' | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba app/product/page.tsx && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba package.json | head -20 && git diff --check && git status --short'
